name: Djulai
source:
Djulai is the oldest out of Nhô Chico and Maria's children.
He's 31 years old and is on the spectrum.
Besides Lucinda, he's the only one who isn't married yet.
He's very caring and shy.

[From [url=https://gongonstudio.itch.io/a-kiss-from-death]itch.io[/url]]
